subject: Short ask: 5-min review + microgrant option for Skylens
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@skylens.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Short ask: 5-min review + microgrant option for Skylens

Hi Asha —

Hope your deployment of the vector-search prototype is going well. Quick, low-friction ask: would you be open to leaving a short review of Redwood Inference on either G2 or TrustRadius? A 2–3 sentence note about latency and the Dedicated pool behavior would be super helpful for our product team and for other teams evaluating us.

We want to make this as easy as possible — two options: an e-gift card ($100) or we can convert the same amount into a microgrant to donate to a nonprofit you pick. No obligation either way; we just want an honest write-up.

If yes, reply with your preferred site (G2 or TrustRadius) and whether you prefer the e-gift or the donation. I can send a shareable link and a one-click submission flow that takes <5 minutes.

Attached: review-invite.pdf (short template + suggested bullets).

Thanks again for your partnership — appreciate anything you can share.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0137

Subject: Re: Short ask: 5-min review + microgrant option for Skylens

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the note. We had a good week with the pilot — happy to help. TrustRadius would be better for our procurement team to see (they look there first).

I like the donation option and would prefer a microgrant to a small STEM education nonprofit we support — can you provide any wording suggestions or bullet points to copy into the form? Also, if you need a named quote from our CTO, loop him in (he's cc'd on internal threads usually).

Timeline: I can get something published by next Thu (19th).

Appreciate it — Asha

Could one of you:
